liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Estimated Prophet goes far out into adventurous territory; Estimated Prophet was smoking, according to an attendee [7][9]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The China > Rider pairing rocks [7]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The reviewer says this was the only He's Gone they ever heard live [9]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer likens the Stella Blue to a Morning Dew [10]
- **Turn On Your Love Light** (1 review): Love Light and US Blues close the show with smoking versions [8]

## The recordings

- **gd91-05-03.sbd.ladner.8831.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is well balanced and full; The sound is very clear and highly dynamic from start to finish [8][10]
- **gd1991-05-03.sbd.miller.109233.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 163 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: This soundboard transfer sounds fantastic [12]
- **gd1991-05-03.142435.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 163 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1991-05-03.142256.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 163 min [4]

## Around the show

- Attendee describes a mellow parking lot scene and recalls KZAP doing a simulcast of the show [9]
- Attendee spent the day with friends here for a twentieth birthday, then went to the 5/4 show [13]
- Attendee recalls jumping off a railroad bridge over a river in the woods near the parking lot [15]
- Overshadowed by the next two nights; the Cal Expo run is overshadowed by Las Vegas before and Shoreline after [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-05-03.sbd.ladner.8831.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > C > DAT > CDR [1]. Also: Soundboard source to DAT, cloned to DAT, then CDR; seeded to etree by neolevo/candyman [1]
- **gd1991-05-03.sbd.miller.109233.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) Set 2: SBD -> Dat (48k) [3]
- **gd1991-05-03.142435.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]
- **gd1991-05-03.142256.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead cal Expo facade Artwork.](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/cal-expo-facade-artwork-2) [18]
